items.title: Docker/Systemd alert cooldowns hardcoded (FR-004 drift)
items.problem: engine.go:206 and 248 use a literal 15-minute cooldown for Docker/Systemd transition alerts while FR-004 promises per-rule configurable cooldown. Either add cooldown config to Docker/Systemd rule types or document the divergence in FR-004.

items.title: Stream-encrypt backup files instead of loading whole DB in RAM
items.problem: backup_crypto.go:32 reads entire backup file into memory before AES-GCM. On Pi with low RAM + growing DB, large backups risk OOM. Also encryption runs before max-upload-size check. Replace with chunked AEAD (age, NaCl secretstream, or manual counter+Seal per chunk).

items.title: Prune stale keys from alerts.Engine cooldowns map
items.problem: engine.go:28 cooldowns map grows unbounded for Docker/Systemd keys as container/service names churn. Either prune during evaluate() (drop entries > 2x max cooldown old) or limit the map size.

items.title: ALTER TABLE migrations swallow all errors, not just duplicate-column
items.problem: sqlite.go:183-187 uses _,_ = db.Exec(...) so any failure mode that isn't 'column already exists' is silent. Replace with an error check that logs non-'duplicate column' errors and optionally aborts startup.

items.title: Validate backup local_path server-side (allowlist root, reject symlinks, forbid non-printable chars)
items.problem: server.go:305-308 + sqlite.go:210 accept any path the admin submits. Add validation: (a) must be absolute and under a configured BACKUP_ROOT, (b) reject symlinks, (c) reject NULL bytes and control chars (defense against SQL path injection in VACUUM INTO which cannot be parameterized).

items.title: Log template.Execute error in renderLogin
items.problem: handlers_auth.go:154 ignores tmpl.Execute error. Wrap errors with log.Printf and unify template error handling across handlers.

items.title: Surface missing ULTRON_SECRET_KEY at startup, not lazily
items.problem: internal/database/secrets.go:33-44 — plaintext-storage warning is sync.Once-gated and only fires on first secret use, possibly long after process start. Log the warning unconditionally during cmd/ultron-ap startup, and expose it on /healthz.

items.title: Validate backup LocalPath against an allowed directory
items.problem: internal/database/sqlite.go:205-215 — Backup(dstPath) does not validate the path. SQL escaping is correct, but operator-controlled path can overwrite arbitrary files writable by the daemon. Reject non-absolute paths, .. segments, paths outside a configured backup root; check writability.

items.title: Persist brute-force lockout to SQLite + background cleanup
items.problem: internal/auth/bruteforce.go:29-62 — attempts/locks are in-memory only; restart wipes them. Cleanup is lazy, only on next login attempt. Move to SQLite, run cleanupExpiredBruteForceAttempts on a 5-minute ticker.

items.title: Bind action execution and audit log into one transaction
items.problem: internal/database/actions.go:21-27 — LogAction is a standalone insert. If a Docker action succeeds but the log write fails, audit trail is incomplete. Wrap action + LogAction in one sql.Tx.

items.title: Filter helper log output before returning to web process
items.problem: cmd/ultron-helper/main.go:190-232 — dmesg/ps/journalctl raw output is shipped to the unprivileged web process. ps can include secrets in argv; journal can leak env. Cap byte size, strip sensitive ps fields, define per-source redaction policy.

items.title: Promote CSP from Report-Only to enforced + add report endpoint
items.problem: internal/server/middleware.go:63 — CSP runs Report-Only with no /api/csp-report endpoint. Add the endpoint, log violations one release cycle, then flip the header to enforced.

items.title: Add SO_PEERCRED check in helper IPC (defense-in-depth)
items.problem: cmd/ultron-helper/main.go:43-105 — current Unix socket protection (mode 0o660 + group) is the standard pattern, but adding SO_PEERCRED to verify the connecting process UID matches the configured ultron-ap user provides defense-in-depth against group misconfiguration. Reclassified from BG-004 (audit overcalled severity — current behavior is correct, this is hardening).

items.title: SSE per-IP cap should not blindly trust X-Forwarded-For
items.problem: internal/server/sse.go:479-493 — clientIPFromRequest trusts XFF first value with no proxy allowlist. Real on a proxied deployment but the actual deploy is direct on LAN/VPN, so impact is bounded. Either ignore XFF or only honor when RemoteAddr is in trusted-proxy list. Reclassified from BG-006.

items.title: Log JSON unmarshal errors in notification handlers
items.problem: internal/server/handlers_notifications.go:90 — json.Unmarshal error ignored in handleNotificationTest. If stored config is corrupted, the test sender uses zero-valued cfg fields and the user sees a confusing 'test failed' message instead of 'config corrupted'. Capture err, log it, return a clearer error to the UI. Reclassified from BG-007 (audit overstated impact — no data loss, just UX/observability).

items.title: Feature: lan-devices — discover & track LAN devices via ICMP sweep + ip neigh
items.problem: Pi runs on eth0 in 192.168.1.0/24; gateway/cloudflare/dns probes already cover WAN reachability. Add per-device discovery: 5-min ICMP sweep over /24 + read ip neigh + OUI vendor lookup → device list (IP, MAC, vendor, online/offline, last_seen) persisted in SQLite. No apt installs (uses unprivileged ICMP already enabled via ping_group_range). UI lives at /network. v1 scope: no per-device WiFi signal (router-cooperation required, not feasible from a guest host) and no per-device bandwidth. mDNS hostname enrichment is a v2 follow-up. Cost: ~250 ARP packets in 3s every 5min, negligible Pi/network impact.

items.title: Feature: insights-engine — declarative rules engine producing real-time verdicts across all modules
items.problem: Today Ultron tells you WHAT is happening (CPU 90%, RTT 200ms) but not WHAT IT MEANS. Build a declarative rules engine: each rule = condition over telemetry vars + verdict + severity + recommendation. Reusable across system/network/services/devices. Examples: cpu>=90 AND temp>=75 → 'thermal throttling probable, kill heavy loads'; gateway ok AND cloudflare fail → 'LAN ok, ISP/WAN down'; ram>=90 AND swap>0 → 'memory pressure, inspect processes'. Verdicts surface in dashboard's Operational Indicators section and SSE-stream. Highest-leverage piece: every future module gains diagnostic capability for free by adding rules. Pairs with /help page (BL-018) which becomes the documentation surface for verdict definitions in two voices (technical + non-technical).

items.title: Feature: help-page — glossary & rule-verdict documentation in technical + non-technical voices
items.problem: /help (or /glossary) page documenting Ultron terminology and the verdicts produced by the insights-engine (BL-017). Each entry has two voices: technical (what the metric measures, thresholds, source code path) and non-technical (what it means for the user in plain language). Verdicts from BL-017 deep-link here. Bootstrap content: gateway/cloudflare/dns probe semantics, WAN state machine, jitter/loss/RTT, CPU/RAM/temp thresholds, services/containers health states, VPN peers.

items.title: Task: ui-audit — analysis pass over all Ultron pages, output prioritized punch-list
items.problem: Analysis (NOT build) task. Walk every page (dashboard, network, services, docker, alerts, history, logs, settings, login) and produce a prioritized punch-list of: (1) layout inconsistencies, (2) card-disposition / visual-hierarchy issues, (3) duplicated info, (4) missing pickers / poor input ergonomics (esp. settings), (5) responsive breakpoints. Out of scope: visual redesign. Goal: feed concrete tickets into the settings-revamp feature and any focused UI cleanups. Output: backlog/ui-audit-2026-Q2.md (markdown punch-list, no code).

items.title: Feature: settings-revamp — typed pickers, validation, structure (extends settings-page-ui-improvements)
items.problem: Settings page is the weakest UI in Ultron: raw inputs, no pickers, minimal validation, weak hierarchy. The existing backlog/settings-page-ui-improvements/ folder already has the seed (mobile-first layout, dangerous-action confirmation with countdown, design-token reuse). This BL extends it with: typed input pickers (time, intervals, thresholds, color-coded severity selectors), client+server validation with inline error states, sectioned navigation, search/filter for settings, and exposure of insights-engine (BL-017) rule thresholds as first-class settings once that ships. Sequenced AFTER ui-audit (BL-019) so concrete prioritization comes from the audit punch-list.

items.title: Deploy verification: track binary SHA on Pi
items.problem: No way to verify whether the running prod binary matches the latest committed build. Today: SSH + sha256sum + manual compare. Need a /version endpoint exposing build commit SHA, or a Make target 'deploy-verify' that diffs local arm64 SHA vs remote Pi SHA. Bonus: emit current commit at startup. Also: stale copies exist at /usr/local/bin/ultron-ap and ~/ultron-ap/ — clean up as part of deploy hygiene.
